label: 🌀 인디고 방염 삼기법 — 30·40·60대
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body group shot.
Three women in a row, evenly spaced with NO GAP between them, arranged left to right.
LEFT: mid thirties. CENTER: early forties. RIGHT: early sixties.
All three hourglass figures, defined waists and rounded hips.
LEFT hair: black, high tight bun. CENTER hair: dark brown, two low braids. RIGHT hair: grey-white, wrapped in a cotton band.

POSE — THREE DIFFERENT STANCES, NOT mirror images, staggered heights:
LEFT is angled away at 45 degrees with hips turned back, torso twisting forward so the chest rotates toward the lens, head turned over the shoulder.
CENTER sits on a low bench, hips angled to one side, torso twisting toward the camera, one hand planted on the bench behind her.
RIGHT stands in near-profile at 70 degrees, chest opening toward the lens, one arm lifted to shoulder height.
CONTACT: LEFT's inner hand rests on CENTER's shoulder; RIGHT's inner hand rests on CENTER's forearm.

Body fully painted with: indigo resist-dye patterns, no unpainted ground anywhere.
LEFT — Japanese shibori: tight kumo spiderweb rings over the shoulders, itajime folded triangles down the torso, fine kanoko dots covering arms and legs, deep indigo and undyed white.
CENTER — Indian bandhani: thousands of tiny tied-dot circles in dense concentric rings and diamond fields, the same deep indigo and white at the same small scale.
RIGHT — Yoruba adire eleko: pale cassava-paste resist patterns on indigo — olokun concentric rings across the torso, ibadandun grid squares each filled with a different small symbol, comb-drawn line bands down the limbs, same indigo and white.
All three share one indigo register so the group reads as a single dye study. No transition or blending between figures is needed.

SURFACE — MANDATORY: bone-dry chalky matte finish, NO wet sheen, NO gloss, NO specular highlight. Shapes stay flat and graphic, never bulging off the skin.
Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible.
Motifs tightly repeated so each pattern reads as continuous texture at full-body scale.
No panel, no band, no skirt or bodice shape.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border no thicker than a fingerwidth; hands and feet bare. No second band anywhere.
ALL SIX hands fully visible, five separated fingers each, correct anatomy.
Nails long coffin-shaped, all three lacquered matte indigo.

Footwear: all three wear matte white platform stiletto sandals, 3cm platform, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a whitewashed studio wall, three indigo cloth panels mounted behind, one per figure.
LIGHTING: a single hard key from the front right at 45 degrees, raking across ALL THREE bodies from the same side. Weak rim from behind left. NOT symmetrical multi-sided lighting.
Style: high fashion editorial meeting textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 3:4 vertical.
